description: Use this after search_robot_database, or when the model id is known (for example boston-dynamics-spot, unitree-go2 or unitree-g1), to read one record of the open robot database in full: category, specifications, typical uses, status, source, the date the entry was reviewed and the address of the model page on merarobotics.com in every language where it exists. No prices.
